jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology
jobs.description:
Leads the technology organization supporting business units as assigned or aligned, while serving as a strategic partner to the Head of Corporate Systems and Data. This highly visible role combines enterprise technology leadership, portfolio ownership, executive stakeholder management, and operational discipline across a complex platform landscape.

Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end technology strategy, roadmap, and delivery for business units as assigned or aligned, ensuring platforms and capabilities align with business priorities and enterprise architecture standards.
Serve as the primary technology leader for assigned or aligned business unit platforms and capabilities, ensuring integration, adoption, ongoing optimization, and alignment with enterprise technology standards.
Lead technology delivery across assigned or aligned business units, ensuring platforms scale with operational, regulatory, risk, and business requirements.
Oversee technology support, governance, tooling, and operating models for assigned or aligned business units, ensuring effective delivery and service management.
Manage the full technology portfolio budget, including capital and operating spend, vendor contracts, licensing, and resource allocation.
Own capacity and demand management across the portfolio, balancing run-the-business needs with strategic initiatives and making transparent trade-off decisions with stakeholders.
Build and maintain multi-year technology roadmaps incorporating platform modernization, AI and automation opportunities, risk reduction, and regulatory change.
Lead, develop, and grow a team of technology professionals, including managers, engineers, product/platform leads, and business analysts; establish clear career paths, performance practices, and succession plans.
Serve as a trusted technology partner to senior leaders across assigned or aligned business units, translating business needs into technology strategy and communicating complex topics in clear, business-relevant terms.
Act as a strategic partner and force multiplier for the Head of Corporate Systems and Data, driving key organizational initiatives, executive communications, operating rhythm, special projects, workforce planning, and cross-functional alignment.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree
12+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including 5+ years managing large, complex technology organizations and multi-year budgets
Demonstrated experience leading technology for corporate, enabling, or business unit functions in a complex enterprise environment
Direct experience leading enterprise technology platforms and broader business application ecosystems, with the ability to drive integration, adoption, and continuous improvement across assigned or aligned business units
Proven ability to translate strategic planning into disciplined execution across complex portfolios, operating effectively at both vision and delivery-detail level
Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence senior leaders with diverse priorities
Strong financial acumen, including budget planning, portfolio prioritization, vendor negotiation, licensing, and capacity/demand management
Demonstrated people leadership capability, including experience developing talent, building high-performing teams, and fostering accountability, continuous improvement, and customer-centric delivery
Experience managing vendor and partner relationships, including systems integrators and platform providers, to ensure quality delivery and cost efficiency
Ability to exercise discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential, sensitive, and organizational information

Preferred Qualifications

MBA or advanced degree
Experience with complex enterprise platforms, business applications, or risk and control technology environments relevant to assigned or aligned business units
Familiarity with platform governance, service management, vendor management, and technology delivery across multiple business domains
Experience acting in a chief-of-staff, business management, or executive-support capacity
Executive presence and gravitas to represent technology with senior business leaders and, where required, Board-level audiences
Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating structure, clarity, and momentum where it does not yet exist
Strong ability to balance competing priorities across multiple functions while maintaining enterprise focus and sound judgement

Working Conditions

Hybrid-Office environment (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays)
Occasional travel ( Travel may be required for leadership meetings, business planning sessions, offsites, vendor engagements, or cross-functional governance forums

This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion. Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation in order to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.

Compensation

The Salary for this position generally ranges between $220K - $285K. Please note that the salary range is a good faith estimate for this position and actual starting pay is determined by several factors including qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.

Additionally, this position is typically eligible for an Annual Bonus based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at the Company’s discretion.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

This is a hybrid position requiring three days in office per week in one of our hub locations (Philadelphia, PA; Cedar Rapids, IA; Denver, CO). Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position.

About The Function

Enterprise Technology is a global Aegon/Transamerica organization that enables the business to move quickly and deliver the best possible outcomes for clients, while keeping their information safe and secure.

With more than 1,000 employees across the UK, US, Netherlands, Hungary, Spain, and Hong Kong, Enterprise Technology is a diverse, global team. Our experts work across areas such as application development, information security, infrastructure, data & analytics, risk & controls, program management, and architecture. We offer a wide range of career opportunities and are committed to supporting employee development.

Curiosity is the quality we value most. Much of our work involves solving complex problems, applying knowledge in new ways, and continuously improving how we operate. As technology evolves rapidly, we look for inquisitive people who are confident challenging the status quo and helping us drive change.

jobs.title: Director I - Cybersecurity Operations & Incident Response
jobs.description:
Location:
This role requires associates to be in-office 3 days per week, fostering collaboration and connectivity, while providing flexibility to support productivity and work-life balance. This approach combines structured office engagement with the autonomy of virtual work, promoting a dynamic and adaptable workplace.

Please note that per our policy on hybrid/virtual work, candidates not within a reasonable commuting distance from the posting location(s) will not be considered for employment, unless an accommodation is granted as required by law.

The Director, Cybersecurity Operations & Incident Response
is responsible for leading enterprise cybersecurity monitoring, security incident response, and investigative operations across Elevance Health. This role leads the 24x7 Security Operations Center (SOC) and Cyber Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT), ensuring security events and incidents are rapidly identified, investigated, contained, remediated, and communicated. This Director is accountable for operational excellence across a follow-the-sun SOC model, effective execution of the cyber incident response lifecycle, development of highly capable cybersecurity professionals, and continuous improvement of security operations processes and capabilities.

How You Will Make An Impact

Interfaces with key Information Technology (IT) solution teams and vendors. Lead and coordinate cybersecurity incident response activities with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Human Resources, Corporate Security, technology teams, and other business stakeholders as required.
Support engagement with external parties, including law enforcement, regulatory authorities, cyber insurance providers, external counsel, and other third parties during significant cybersecurity investigations and incidents.
Provide timely and accurate briefings to the CISO and senior leadership regarding high-profile cybersecurity incidents, including incident scope, business impact, response status, key decisions, risks, and recommended actions.
Oversee enterprise security monitoring and investigation capabilities, including SIEM-based monitoring, security alert triage, cloud security monitoring, identity-related investigations, malware analysis, digital forensics, threat intelligence consumption, and other security operations functions within the team’s scope.
Provide operational input into the design and adoption of AI-enabled cybersecurity workflows, ensuring solutions enhance analyst effectiveness while maintaining appropriate governance, human oversight, accuracy, and risk controls.
Manage operational readiness for major cybersecurity events, including surge staffing, escalation paths, communications, technical coordination, and transition between normal security operations and formal incident response activities.
Support regulatory, audit, and compliance activities by providing evidence of security monitoring and incident response controls and ensuring alignment with applicable frameworks and requirements, including HIPAA, HITRUST, PCI DSS, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, SOX, SEC cybersecurity requirements, and applicable breach notification obligations.
Develop business-level presentations, operational reporting, incident briefings, and strategic recommendations that enable senior leadership to understand cybersecurity risk, operational performance, capability gaps, and investment priorities.
Hires, trains, coaches, counsels, and evaluate performance of direct reports.

Minimum Requirements

Requires an BA/BS degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field of study and a minimum of 7 years of IT management experience; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background.

Preferred Skills, Capabilities And Experiences

Demonstrated experience leading enterprise Security Operations Center, Cyber Security Incident Response, or comparable cybersecurity operations functions is preferred.
Extensive experience managing cybersecurity incidents across the incident response lifecycle, including identification, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, evidence preservation, and post-incident review is preferred.
Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, or comparable industry certifications are strongly preferred.
Demonstrated record of building high-performing security operations teams and improving operational maturity, investigation quality, analyst effectiveness, and incident response outcomes is preferred.
Prior experience leading a 24x7 enterprise Security Operations Center and Cyber Security Incident Response Team is strongly preferred.
Strong working knowledge of healthcare and cybersecurity regulatory and compliance requirements, including HIPAA, HITRUST, PCI DSS, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, SOX, SEC cybersecurity requirements, and state or federal breach notification requirements is strongly preferred.

Elevance Health is a health company dedicated to improving lives and communities – and making healthcare simpler. We are a Fortune 25 company with a longstanding history in the healthcare industry, looking for leaders at all levels of the organization who are passionate about making an impact on our members and the communities we serve.

Our values and behaviors are the root of our culture. They are how we achieve our strategy, power our business outcomes and drive our shared success - for our consumers, our associates, our communities and our business.

The health of our associates and communities is a top priority for Elevance Health. jobs.title: Director, Provider Technology and Innovation Strategy
jobs.description:
Great companies need great teams to propel their operations. Join the group that solves business challenges and enhances the way we work and grow. Working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values your contributions and puts a premium on work flexibility, learning, and career development.

Summary

Gainwell is seeking an experienced and results-driven, technically minded business leader to manage market, industry, & competitor analysis and product innovation strategies across the Provider Solutions portfolio. Reporting directly to the Senior Vice President and General Manager of Provider Solutions, this leader will be accountable for evaluation of existing products, defining opportunities for enhancement and optimization, and identification new product development to address market opportunities. This role will act as the face of provider product strategy and innovation, driving cross-discipline alignment on product technology and process advancement. A successful candidate will be highly organized, strategic, collaborative, creative, and have exceptional problem solving, analytical, communication and interpersonal skills. They will be a visionary in software products and technology advancement, drawing from best and emerging practices across the technology industry. They will be accountable for overseeing all technology and product advancements from concept through delivery across the Provider portfolio.

Your role in our mission

Conduct Medicaid federal, market, policy, and competitor analysis to inform product strategy and innovation roadmaps.
Analyze and assess target market, and thoroughly understand competitive landscape and market position of solution portfolio, along with federal (CMS) and state mandates.
Develop business cases for new solutions that will add significant value and help Gainwell, and its clients, achieve business success.
Interface with engineering and business leads to derive opportunities and identify technology advancement opportunities and prioritize based on impact.
Closely align with Provider solutions team to understand current technology and how to evolve existing solutions over time through organic and inorganic transformation.
Coordinate strategies, work, and communicate effectively between corresponding leadership roles in Product, Engineering, Implementation, Delivery/Operations, Marketing, and Sales to drive achievement of innovation goals.
Produce and deliver executive reports on technology and innovation vision, strategy, and finances on a routine basis.

What We're Looking For

7-10 years of technology consulting and/or strategy management, with extensive exposure to product management, engineering, implementations, sales/marketing, and delivery.
5–8 years in healthcare strategy consulting and product operations (public sector a plus).
Excellent communicator with a knack for distilling complexity into clarity.
Highly organized, proactive, and discreet—comfortable navigating ambiguity.
Strong understanding of Medicaid, Provider enrollment processes, and CMS regulations (relevant commercial experience is acceptable).
Ability to drive multi-year product technology and innovation roadmaps to achieve measurable business transformation.
Proven achievement bringing new products to market that drive net new business growth.
Experience overseeing multiple complex technology projects and tracking from concept to completion.
Expertise in Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) solutions is preferred.

What You Should Expect In This Role

This opportunity is 100% remote within the United States with opportunity to travel for work up to 10% annually.

The deadline to submit applications for this posting is October 16 2026.

The pay range for this position is $137,100.00 - $195,800.00 per year, however, the base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region, internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Put your passion to work at Gainwell. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. All salaried, full-time candidates are eligible for our generous, flexible vacation policy, a 401(k) employer match, comprehensive health benefits, and educational assistance. We also have a variety of leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

We believe nothing is impossible when you bring together people who care deeply about making healthcare work better for everyone. Build your career with Gainwell, an industry leader. You’ll be joining a company where collaboration, innovation, and inclusion fuel our growth. Learn more about Gainwell at our company website and visit our Careers site for all available job role openings.

jobs.title: IT Program Manager
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

About The IRC

The International Rescue Committee helps people whose lives and livelihoods are shattered by conflict and disaster to survive, recover, and gain control of their future. Founded in 1933 at the request of Albert Einstein, the IRC works with people forced to flee from war, conflict and disaster and the host communities that support them, as well as with those who remain within their homes and communities. At work today in over 40 countries and 26 U.S. cities, we restore safety, dignity and hope to millions who are uprooted and struggling to endure.

The IT department provides end-to-end solutions for the organization including application development & integration, system deployment, quality assurance & testing, and overall Project Management in an effort to help the organization build and implement the best solutions for its business needs.

The Opportunity

Every donation processed, every campaign that lands, every supporter who stays engaged — that's the technology you'll help build and deliver.

As IT Program Manager
, you'll manage the digital platforms behind one of the world's leading humanitarian organizations, directly enabling the fundraising that funds life-saving programs for displaced communities across the globe. This is a high-impact, fast-paced role at the intersection of technology delivery, stakeholder engagement, and mission-driven purpose.

You'll be a core member of our Project Management team, working across a modern MarTech ecosystem — including donation and e-commerce platforms (Fundraise Up, Springboard)
, our website (Drupal)
, Salesforce CRM
, Databricks
, email marketing (Pardot)
, and SMS platforms (Mobile Commons, Mogli)
. You'll own the delivery of enhancements, integrations, and new capability launches that keep the IRC's digital supporter experience best-in-class.

Why Join Us?

Real-world impact — your work directly supports humanitarian programs serving millions of people in crisis.
Breadth and ownership — lead a complex, multi-platform portfolio with genuine strategic influence from day one.
Collaborative culture — work alongside Product Managers, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders in a distributed, multicultural team that's deeply committed to its mission.
Modern delivery — Agile/Scrum at the core, with room to shape how the team works.
Remote-first flexibility — work from anywhere in the US as part of a truly global organization.

What You'll Do

Drive end-to-end program delivery
Own the full lifecycle of multiple concurrent MarTech initiatives — from scope definition and roadmap planning through to launch and post-delivery review. Develop and maintain detailed project plans, work breakdown structures, and product backlogs, ensuring delivery against time, budget, and quality targets.

Champion Agile ways of working
Serve as Scrum Master for your project and product teams — coaching on Agile principles, facilitating sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and reviews, and proactively removing blockers to keep delivery on track.

Keep stakeholders informed and aligned
Prepare clear, timely status reports covering scope, milestones, risks, and budget. Communicate confidently with audiences from engineers to senior executives, tailoring your message appropriately. Manage expectations and build trust across business and technology teams.

Manage budgets and vendors
Oversee budget tracking and vendor invoicing for your portfolio. Support cost estimation, validate expenditure, and contribute to the annual budget planning process to ensure initiatives are delivered within financial targets.

Lead business analysis activities
Work with the team to define and track functional and technical requirements, document current and future state processes, and coordinate testing activities. Partner closely with Business Analysts to ensure delivery is grounded in well-understood business needs.

Manage risk proactively
Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans. Surface issues early, escalate where needed, and keep the project leadership team ahead of potential blockers.

Shape the roadmap
Partner with Product Managers to build out product and project roadmaps that reflect both business priorities and technical realities, contributing to a coherent long-term vision for the MarTech portfolio.

What You'll Bring

You'll need:

3-6 years of experience in IT project or program management, ideally across e-commerce systems, donation platforms, website CMS, or other Marketing Technology.
A strong track record of delivering multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget.
Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, or similar).
Experience using project management tools such as Jira or Monday.com.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - comfortable engaging with variety of project collaborators from developers to executives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize data and drive decision-making.
High levels of organization, initiative, and the ability to work independently in a distributed and fast-paced environment.

It'd Be Great If You Have

Experience with any of the platforms in scope: Fundraise Up, Springboard, Drupal, Salesforce, Pardot, Databricks.
Familiarity with non-profit fundraising, digital marketing, or supporter engagement processes.
Experience managing third-party vendors and project budgets.
Knowledge of SDLC methodologies (Waterfall and Agile).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio for producing high-quality project artifacts.

Bonus Points For

A PMP, CSM, CSPO, or SAFe certification.
Experience working in international development, human rights, or a related field.
An understanding of payment processing platforms (Stripe, PayPal, etc.).

Benefits And Working Environment

Standard office working environment.
Currently the team is working in a hybrid model with one day per week in the office (unless the employee’s location is outside of NYC or London).
This role may require working remotely full or part time.
Some domestic or international travel depending on portfolio and project needs
UK-based candidates will need to work at a modified schedule of 12 PM - 8 PM at least 3 days a week.
Some domestic or international travel depending on portfolio and project needs

Compensation:
(US Pay Range: $88,277 - $103,222/yr; UK Pay Range: £49,598 - £60,040/yr) Posted pay ranges apply to US-based candidates. Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards:
All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

As a Global Security Program Manager on Notion’s Global Safety & Security team, you’ll help protect our people, workplaces, and operations across a distributed global portfolio. This role exists to bring greater consistency to physical security programs as Notion scales—strengthening technology, vendor operations, incident readiness, and local execution without losing the welcoming experience we want employees and guests to feel. You’ll work across Workplace, People, IT, Legal, business leaders, vendors, and building partners, balancing hands-on operations with repeatable program design. This is a remote role based in the United States, with travel to Notion offices, events, and other locations expected—up to 50% based on operational needs.

A Great Tuesday

Review regional differences in access control or visitor management and turn them into clear priorities for the global parity project.
Work with a vendor or building manager to resolve a security gap, balancing local context with global standards.
Draft an incident update, using AI to improve clarity, then validate the details and judgment behind the message.
Coordinate international project work while responding thoughtfully to an urgent operational issue.

What You'll Achieve

By your 90th day, kick off a global physical security parity project that creates shared visibility into regional practices, gaps, and priorities.
By your 90th day, use AI to accelerate clear, effective communications, reduce busywork, and keep detail-heavy work accurate and reviewable.
By the end of your first year, take ownership of Notion’s physical security technology program, improving how systems, data, and operating practices support safe and resilient workplaces.
By the end of your first year, demonstrate program ownership in one major physical security or safety pillar, such as business continuity and disaster recovery, event security, travel risk management, monitoring operations, crisis management, guard force operations, or governance.
By the end of your first year, deliver multiple international projects with clear plans, sound judgment, and effective coordination across regions, vendors, and cross-functional partners.

Skills You'll Need To Bring

Demonstrated ability to own physical security or safety programs across multiple sites or regions, including security technology, access control, incident response, or vendor operations.
Effective project management skills, with the ability to move multiple international projects from ambiguity to clear plans, decisions, and delivery.
Clear, thoughtful communication with internal partners, vendors, building management, and local stakeholders—especially when translating security requirements into practical action.
A service-oriented approach and eagerness to help create secure, welcoming workplace experiences; you bring curiosity, ownership, and sound judgment to how you work with others.
Novice AI proficiency and a willingness to use AI as a practical collaborator for communication, accuracy checks, documentation, and reducing repetitive work.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $208,000 – $233,000 per year.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. jobs.description:
Co-founder, CTO/CISO | Grantentic

Grantentic ( https://www.grantentic.us/ ) is an AI platform that writes SBIR/STTR Phase I proposals for small businesses and deep tech founders, turning a months-long, consultant-led process into one that takes days or weeks. Every proposal is grounded in a corpus of 40,028 verified winning SBIR abstracts across NSF, NASA, and DoD, with fabrication controls enforced in code.
